::: {.rq-lesson}
**How it works.** Take the **[pre-test](pretest.qmd)** for a baseline, then clear worlds in order. Each world has a short briefing, levels of questions and a **boss**. Earn **XP** (★ = 10/20/30), keep a **daily streak**, collect **badges**, and rank up from *Field Volunteer* to *Chief Biostatistician*.

- First try = full XP · second try = ½ · later = ¼ · **hints cost XP** (3, 5, 8) · *Show answer* = 0 XP
- A world unlocks after you reach the pass mark in the previous one (you can always override: it is *your* learning)
- Progress is saved **in this browser only**. Use *Export* to back it up or move devices
:::
